definition: a country with its own government
description: In a grand marble hall, two animated leaders wearing sashes each press a wax seal onto a treaty document in front of their national banners, one teal with a circle and one orange with a triangle, then shake hands and pose side by side as their delegations applaud.
transcript: My country signs today. Mine signs too. Two free nations. Friends.

taps.target: the woman in the teal sash

en.question: What are the two leaders doing?

de.answer: Sie geben sich vor ihren Bannern die Hand.
de.question: Was machen die beiden Staatschefs?

es.answer: Se están dando la mano delante de sus estandartes.
phrases: fruncir el ceño ante el documento
es.question: ¿Qué están haciendo los dos líderes?

fr.answer: Ils se serrent la main devant leurs bannières.
phrases: regarder le document en fronçant les sourcils
